title: ECMAScript: Test if Array subclassing supported
product-requirement: Device needs to support classes that extend the Array class and it's behaviour w.r.t. the length property.
specification: Terminals MUST implement at least ECMAScript 6.0 [1]
assertion: An instance of a class that subclasses Array will update its length property when properties with names that are array indexes are added and removed

changelog.summary: Verify that subclasses of Array continue to behave as an Array
